description_text:
Suzuki Jimny
Lowpoly model of japanese small offroad car

Suzuki Jimny is a series of four-wheel drive off-road mini SUVs, manufactured and marketed by Japanese automaker Suzuki since 1970. Originally belonging to the kei class, Japan’s light automobile tax/legal class. Suzuki has marketed almost 3 million Jimnys in 194 countries. All four Jimny generations have separate frame and body. The body has no structural carrying role. It serves only as a cabin to protect the occupants from the elements, provide comfort, and protect them in the case of a crash. All four Jimny generations have dependent suspension (solid-beam axles) both at the front and rear axles. This used to be a common suspension design for all-terrain vehicles up to 1990s, but has become a rarity in vehicle design in the 21st century.

3 cars in set: Basic model + flat shaded model + tuned version. Each with own texture.

Check also my other aircrafts and cars

description_text:
Since 1931 Porsche has produced luxury sport cars, sedans, and SUVs for an adoring public. They have managed to become one of the top manufacturers of high-end vehicles in the world, but this reputation, and its follow-through, hasn’t happened by accident. It is the result of years of creating quality and keeping up with the latest and greatest automotive technology. Heck, in many cases that have been on the delivery end of that particular stick. What we mean by ‘little things’ is basically this: What are the little touches, extras, and various options does Porsche offer that takes the vehicles they make out of the proverbial box and set them right on center stage? Many things, believe us, many; you are likely very aware of a lot of them, if you are a fan of the Porsche brand at all. With all of the little extras in mind, we thought we would point our spotlight on one in particular, and our choice may surprise you. We didn’t choose a Porsche engine or transmission, or one of their knockout body styles. We didn’t choose the plush interior or loaded infotainment system…not really, anyway. Heck, we didn’t even choose to titter over added safety measures. In a way, however we chose to touch base here and there on all of them.

description_text:
These features were paired with low weight and thus lower unsprung masses compared with steel wheels. The lower the unsprung masses, the lower the moment of inertia and the better the handling. Consequently, the Type 35 was easier and more precise to steer, it braked better and the suspension was more comfortable than comparable racing cars of the time. During these early races, which often lasted several hours or even days, drivers were thus able to drive for longer, reach higher speeds and be more concentrated at the wheel. A reason why Bugatti drivers dominated the world’s race tracks between 1925 and 1930. Even today, the Type 35 does not ask too much of its drivers.
Bugatti produced seven different types of aluminium wheels over the next few years. For the Type 35, Type 39 and Type 51 racing cars, the French company produced three different versions: a 20-inch variant featuring small brakes, a 19-inch design with large brakes and 19-inch drop centre rims featuring large brakes. The cast wheels with eight wide aluminium spokes became Bugatti’s signature feature in addition to the horseshoe-shaped radiator grille. The design was also used for Bugatti’s first hyper sports car of modern times, the Veyron as the Veyron Fbg par Hermès special model.

description_text:
A break Disc composed by 4 diferent components, assembly in Catia V5 and rendered in Keyshot. All files included.
A disc brake is a type of brake that uses the calipers to squeeze pairs of pads against a disc or a rotor to create friction. This action slows the rotation of a shaft, such as a vehicle axle, either to reduce its rotational speed or to hold it stationary. The energy of motion is converted into waste heat which must be dispersed.
Hydraulically actuated disc brakes are the most commonly used form of brake for motor vehicles, but the principles of a disc brake are applicable to almost any rotating shaft. The components includes the disc, master cylinder, caliper (which contains cylinder and two brake pads) on both side of the disc.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownThe Overall ConceptThis premium vehicular asset is expertly engineered for modern arcade racing games, summer-themed open worlds, and high-fidelity driving simulators. Representing a luxury high-performance sports car with a distinct, custom beachside livery, this model serves as an exceptional Hero-Asset for player garages, special seasonal event unlocks, or high-end environmental set dressing. It delivers a highly dynamic, eye-catching visual presence while maintaining optimized geometry for seamless integration into real-time engines.
Vibrant Coastal Livery and Gloss FinishThe sports car features a striking, scenic aesthetic meticulously textured with professional-grade PBR materials. The primary chassis simulates a premium gloss-coated wrap depicting crashing ocean waves, detailed white sea foam across the hood, and a golden sandy beach blending along the lower side panels and rocker guards. This artistic exterior contrasts perfectly against a solid black roof panel, blacked-out multi-spoke alloy rims, and sleek side mirrors, providing a clear visual narrative of an elite, custom-styled sports vehicle.
Opaque Black Windows and Optimized OpticsAdhering strictly to professional optimization standards, the entire greenhouse cabin glass assembly—including the front windshield, side windows, and rear glass—as well as the prominent oval headlight lenses are modeled using solid, opaque black geometry with a high-gloss specular finish. This completely eliminates the heavy performance cost of complex interior cabin rendering, dashboard modeling, and refractive transparency, keeping the asset exceptionally lightweight without sacrificing its high-end look.
Sleek Aerodynamic SilhouetteThe unit is characterized by its low-slung, aerodynamic sports profile, featuring aggressive front air intakes, curved muscular fenders, and large low-profile racing tires. The structural configuration is instantly readable, offering excellent visual clarity as a fast, agile luxury vehicle. The asset is meticulously structured to present a flawless front three-quarter perspective, ensuring premium visual impact and a 100% frame-fill presence in your marketplace renders or garage-selection UI screens.
Optimized Game-Ready GeometryBuilt specifically for real-time engine performance, the model features a highly optimized footprint suitable for PC, console, and mobile racing titles. From the smooth, sweeping organic curves of the streamlined bodywork to the clean, sharp edge-flow of the blacked-out alloy wheels, all components are engineered for maximum efficiency. The mesh is logically constructed, allowing developers to easily rig the front steering rotation, individual wheel spins, and apply dynamic lighting reflections in engines like Unreal Engine and Unity.
Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, Optimized PBR Texture Maps (4K).
Game-Engine Ready: The main vehicle chassis and all four high-performance wheels are logically separated as distinct meshes with correct, centered pivot points, allowing for immediate integration of arcade vehicle physics and wheel animations.
Quick Tip: Take full advantage of the high-gloss body paint and opaque windows by maximizing the environment's reflection probes or setting up sharp directional sunlight. The specular highlights moving across the ocean-wave graphics will look incredibly vibrant under coastal or sunny midday race conditions.

description_text:
4K - PBR Antique Wooden Nightstand - UE4 Ready low-poly 3d model ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games and other real-time apps.
Here is a game ready vintage windsor-styled wooden chair with the utmost care to obtain a standard that is both visually exquisite and performance friendly for real-time applications.
Each texture set comes with both the original TIFF format textures (Uncompressed) as well as their TGA equivalents, for use in a game engine (UE4/Unity).
All the texture maps adhere to the following naming convention:

  - *_BASE (The Color/Base/Albedo Map) 

  - *_NRM (The Normal Map - DirectX - Invert Green Channel for OpenGL) 

  - *_ROUGH (The Roughness/Microsurface Map) 

  - *_AO (The Ambient Occlusion Map) 

  - *_ARM (A map containing the previously mentioned AO, Roughness, and Metallic maps into each of the images individual channels of a single image. Conserving texture memory in certain applications (UE4 for example.) The ARM suffix corresponds to RGB in that:

Red Channel = Ambient Occlusion Green Channel = Roughness Map Blue Channel = Metallic Map

description_text:
Dome Zero RL80 Low poly renderableFormats included: OBJ, FBX, Marmoset, Max 
Japanese concept and racing car. PBR and Smooth ready.
This is not a printable model 
If you have any questions please don’t hesitate to contact me. I will respond you ASAP. I encourage you to check my other 3D models.
En 1976 Minoru Hayashi  tenía la idea de crear un pequeño súper coche que fuese capaz de competir en las 24 horas de Le Mans. El proyecto fue adquirido por Dome Co. Ltd, pero nunca llegaron a cumplir los requisitos para ser homologado en Japón como vehículo de calle. Con enfoque en USA, numerosas empresas de juguetes llegaron a un acuerdo con la compañía para crear miniaturas del modelo. (Dome Zero era el vehículo en el que se transformaba Rodimus Prime un sustituto fallido de Optimus).Con estos ingresos para la compañía, por fin Minoru Hayashi pudo ver cumplido su sueño de crear una versión que compitiera en las 24 horas de Le Mans. En 1979 no consiguió acabar la carrera, en 1980 lo hizo en el último lugar.

description_text:
3D printable chassis 1:32 scale slot car chassis to sit under the Miller Meteor available elsewhere.
The chassis has been designed to accommodate a standard motor, running inline.
The guide post will accommodate a Slotting Plus guide.
Print body at 199.2mm long. Do not scale width/height.
Chassis can be printed at 0.28mm layer height. On an Ender3 Pro this takes approximately two hours.
Build surface supports are recommended for the rear of the chassis, which is elevated in comparison to the front.
Included is the chassis, a brace for the motor and rear axle. These screw in place with M2.4mm screws (untapped holes are 2mm in diameter - this is also true for the grub screw holes on the front axle).
With regards to body fitment, apply the standard methods; posts or braces as you see fit on the chassis.
0.2 layer height is fine, but 0.12 is naturally better.
Recommend supports for the tail and running boards, and a raft to ensure the flag post doesn't lift

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 40
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 39
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

The Celtic symbol of love and eternity
A coin with great meaning, perfect to give to your partner or children as a symbol of eternal love. Also, it is an excellent decorative object.

The Perenne knot is a Celtic symbol that represents eternal love. It is a knot that can not be undone and that has no beginning or end, so it was used to concretize the infinite union of a couple. In each generation, parents give this symbol to their children, to perpetuate their lineage.

description_text:
Why Do you need to buy this 3D model ?
I modeled and created this Car Back Bench to Impala 1967, but it's not 100 % similar to original one, so this seat can be use in any classic vehicle because is a very commun design and will add an air of simplicity  in any composition of sort. 
And also I created 3 collections of PBR options painted textures for Low Poly to add a pinch of lifetime realism for this model to really suits well in everywere that you do and I included materials also in the docs.
There are 3 ways to use it and one of these It's going to fits well in any game engine and real time renders because it's very low poly with good normals and nice topoligy, no ngons or trianguls that allows you to modifie preatty easy the mesh and the normals are fine and will be more easy to put modifiers such subdivision also. And only in the 3DSMax and Blender doc you already have crease on the edges to make easy to use OpenSubdivisions without the need to slide edges. So I creted 2 options of use for who works with reytrace renders or use in game engines with textures maps istead and all with 4K and 2K resolution that I baked and will brings the same qualitie with no subdivion and not only that, if you don't want to use subdivision I included High Poly mesh in the file.
( I just don't recommend to use the PBR textures in High Poly Meshe, because as you can see in the imagens both have diferent topology and there is not UV in the High Poly also.) 
And the object has proper pivot points locations to make it easy and precise to put in any place, and also easy to move and animate the open.
Resume everything, you are going to buy It's a model that can be use and reused and It will fits in anything that you make it without trouble and saving thousands of time.
More Details

  - Comes with low poly and high Poly meshes, 2 Docs ( Blender and 3DSMax 2021/2018), 3 presets of PBR Textures and 4 materials in the doc files

  - Clean topology and optimized geometry

  - Good heirarchy and rename objects

  - All UVs unwrapped and there is not overlapping

I hope you enjoy and for any problems, wishs or questions just contact me in the comments.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 39
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 50
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Mid Size 4 door sedan
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V6
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 7
Rear bumper:Tier 5
Dashboard:Tier 2
Exhaust:Tier 1
Wheels:Tier 1
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:No
Trim Color:Glossy chrome
Interior Leather Color:White
Tinted Rear Windows:Yes
Wheel Color:Grey

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 38
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 50
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Extended Wheelbase 4 door coupe
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V6
Sport pack:NoYes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 11
Rear bumper:Tier 4
Dashboard:Tier 1
Exhaust:Tier 1
Wheels:Tier 5
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Sport Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:YesNo
Trim Color:Glossy black
Interior Leather Color:White
Tinted Rear Windows:No
Wheel Color:Alloy

description_text:
Highly engineered carbon racing machines, stylish steel retro bikes and every bike in between: They can not do without the perfect tires. Pick your tire from the 4 ring models and wear it as a ring. Three variants have a tread, one ring is a slick. Because of their small width, the rings can even be stacked, so you can wear several on one finger.  
Dimensions and details of the ring profile: The ring cross-section is (wide x high) 3.5x4mm. The tire tread is 0.6mm thick and the finest part runs out in 0.14mm width. This makes the model perfect for testing and calibrating your 3D printer. Because of the fine details, the model does not comply with the design guides of the suppliers of the lost wax metal casting. If you insist on casting it anyway, you will have to expect softened details in the final casting. It is best to ask the supplier for an estimate. The rings are ring size 58, if you need a different ring size you can scale the model.
As a trained goldsmith with years of experience in 3D design, I work with great care. If something does not fit, please feel free to contact me.
If my designs inspire you contact me for your personal ideas.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 36
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 32
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Extended Wheelbase 2 door coupe
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V8
Sport pack:No

Exhaust:Tier 3
Wheels:Tier 2
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:Yes
Trim Color:Glossy chrome
Interior Leather Color:Black
Tinted Rear Windows:No
Wheel Color:Black

description_text:
Universal joint, fully functional, accurately modeled, and ready for use in CAD, CGI, and 3D print applications. Modeled in Autodesk Inventor and provided in multiple file formats. Perfect for both digital and physical mechanical design projects.
Universal joints are used to couple two rotating shafts that are not parallel. They are commonly used with automobile drive shafts, steering columns, and a variety of industrial equipment.
Universal joint specifications:

  - Shaft diameter: 1.000in

  - Outside diameter: 1.500in

  - Overall length: 4.000in

  - Maximum operarting angle: 30.0deg

3 Provisions are included to mount the universal joint to your shafts:

  - Keyway cut into bore

  - Thru hole for spring pins

  - Pilot hole that can be drilled and tapped to accept set screws

Universal joint is sized for a 1.000in diameter shaft. But parts can be easily scaled to use with any shaft diameter of your choice, in imperial or metric dimensions.
Scaling factors for common shaft sizes:

  - 1.000in shaft = 100% scale

  - 0.750in shaft = 75% scale

  - 0.500in shaft = 50% scale

  - 0.250in shaft = 25% scale

  - 25mm shaft = 98.43% scale

  - 20mm shaft = 78.74% scale

  - 15mm shaft = 59.06% scale

  - 10mm shaft = 39.37% scale

Native Autodesk Inventor 2012 files are provided with intact browser trees and parameter tables to allow full configurability and customization.
Product includes:

  - 3 Autodesk Inventor 2012 part files for CAD (IPT format) - includes fork, block, and pin

  - 2 Autodesk Inventor 2012 assembly files for CAD (IAM format) - includes finished assembly and exploded assembly

  - 1 Autodesk Inventor 2012 drawing file for CAD (IDW format)

  - 5 STP models for CAD - includes finished assembly, exploded assembly, fork, block, and pin

  - 5 SAT models for CAD - includes finished assembly, exploded assembly, fork, block, and pin

  - 5 IGS models for CAD - includes finished assembly, exploded assembly, fork, block, and pin

  - 3 STL models for 3D print - fork, block, and pin

  - 1 OBJ model for CGI - includes finished assembly

  - 1 3DS model for CGI - includes finished assembly

  - 1 FBX model for CGI - includes finished assembly

  - 2 Viewable, read-only 3d models (DWF format, open using Autodesk Design Review free download) - includes finished assembly and exploded assembly

  - 1 Detail drawing (DWG format)

  - 1 Detail drawing (PDF format)

description_text:
Mach Landerfrom The Brave Fighter of Legend Da-Garnreplica
[en]
archive contains 2 folders:

  - a folder with the full set of print-ready parts which were redesigned to make the assembly easier

  - a folder with the full set of print-ready parts which are fully compatible with the original toy

assembly.pdfhttps://drive.google.com/open?id=1nYAOFWsF0xjRABj437lHOQGjeY5yat7w
to assemble the toy you will need some additional things which you can see on the attached image (for more details please download assembly.pdf):

  - 2 pins which contain small nails which are suitable to hold front wheels

  - 2 metal spikes 2.2x29mm and 2.2x51mm (hard 2.2mm metal wire will be ok)

  - an M3 screw (3x18mm) and a nut for it

  - 7 pieces of 5.5mm screws

  - 2 screws with a wide head, 5mm long

recommended printing settings:

  - every part already has the correct position for printing (the main part will have a lot of support but it is necessary to print the face of the toy correctly and avoid any skewing, if the main part will be somehow skewed. then other parts will look misplaced after the assembly)

  - it was tested in ABS and PLA

  - layer height: 0.1

  - infill density: 5%

  - support: only touching buildplate

  - support pattern: Concentric

  - support density: 20%

  - buildplate adhesion type: raft

[ru]
архив содержит 2 папки:

  - папка с полным набором деталей, некоторые из которых изменены (отличаются от оригинальной игрушки) для более удобной сборки вручную

  - папка с полным набором деталей, полностью совместимымых с оригинальной игрушкой

инструкция по сборке (assembly.pdf)https://drive.google.com/open?id=1nYAOFWsF0xjRABj437lHOQGjeY5yat7w
для сборки версии с изменёнными деталями понадобятся

  - 2 кнопки, внутри которых содержатся маленькие гвоздики, идеально подходящие под передние колёса

  - 2 металлических стержня 2.2x29мм и 2.2x51мм (подойдёт алюминиевая проволока 2.2мм)

  - винтик М3 (3x18мм) и гайка к нему

  - 7 шурупов 5.5мм

  - 2 шурупа или винтика с широкой шляпкой, длина 5мм

рекомендованные настройки печати:

  - все детали уже в подготовленной для печати позе (у детали main.stl, к сожалению, будет много поддержки, но это необходимо для того, чтобы лицо игрушки напечаталось нормально, и чтобы избежать искривления основоной части, тк в противном случае остальные детали будут иметь большие зазоры)

  - модель протестирована на ABS и PLA пластике

  - layer height: 0.1

  - infill density: 5%

  - support: only touching buildplate

  - support pattern: Concentric

  - support density: 20%

  - buildplate adhesion type: raft

This plugin comes by default with blender and its also really famous

description_text:
High quality nissan s14 ready for game 
(It comes with High and low polygon to edit what you want!)
The Nissan Silvia (Japanese: 日産・シルビア, Nissan Shirubia) is a series of sport coupes based on the Nissan S platform. Although recent models have shared this chassis with other vehicles produced by Nissan (most notably the European 200SX and North American 240SX in the S13 and S14 generations, and 180SX in the Japanese market), the name Silvia is interchangeable with the chassis codes. The Nissan Silvia's main competitors worldwide were the Honda Prelude, Mazda MX-6, Toyota Celica, Mitsubishi Eclipse, Isuzu Impulse, and Honda Integra.
The Silvia name is a variation of the word sylvia, which is a scientific genus term assigned to a class of birds, possibly a reference to the Bluebird which was in production at the time the Silvia was introduced.
(you can use it commercially, for video games, everything)

title: HDR 360 Panorama DTLA Graffiti Alley Cloudy 049 3D model
description_text:
This is a 32-bit floating point 360 degree HDR panoramic equirectangular image of a Downtown Los Angeles industrial alley that is covered in beautiful graffiti.  Shot at 9am in the morning on a very cloudy day for flat strong ambient light with no hard shadows.  This image can be used in any 3D package for Image Based Lighting IBL.  The full range of light in this scene is contained in the HDR image and will be strong enough to illuminate your 3D scene and cast shadows.  I shot this 8 level exposure wedge, with a range from 1/4th sec to 1/4000 in step size of 2 full EV’s.  That gives a range of over 12 EV’s of light in this one exterior pano.  Stop down the image in Nuke and check with the eyedropper to see the full range of pixel values in the double digits throughout the sky.  To see a full rez version and fly around the scene close up please search Tojek_VFX on 360cities website.  Exact location of the shot is Downtown Los Angeles, CA, google map latlong, 34.0322028,-118.23280833338505This pano is part of a full set of 6 images covering this graffiti alleyway complex, pano 5 of 6.

description_text:
This is a 32-bit floating point 360 degree HDR panoramic lat long image of a Downtown Los Angeles neighborhood called Little Tokyo.  Shot at 8am in the morning on a very cloudy day for nice diffuse ambient light with some blue sky.  This image can be used in any 3D package for Image Based Lighting IBL. I shot this 11 level exposure wedge, with a range from 1/4th sec to 1/4000 in step size of 2 full EV’s.  That gives a range of over 12 EV’s of light in this one exterior pano.  To see a full rez version and fly around the scene close up please search Tojek_VFX on 360cities website.  Exact location of the shot is Downtown Los Angeles, CA, google map latlong, 34.049394,-118.239601

title: HDR 360 Panorama 1st Street Viaduct DTLA 97 grassy side 3D model
description_text:
This is a 32-bit floating point 360 degree HDR panoramic lat long image of a Downtown Los Angeles landmark called 1st Street bridge.  Shot at 8am in the morning on a very sunny day for big blue sky, bright low sun, and hard shadows.  This image can be used in any 3D package for Image Based Lighting IBL.  The full range of light in this scene is contained in the HDR image and will be strong enough to illuminate your 3D scene and cast hard shadows.  I shot this 8 level exposure wedge, with a range from 1/4th sec to 1/4000 in step size of 2 full EV’s.  That gives a range of over 12 EV’s of light in this one exterior pano.  To see a full rez version and fly around the scene close up please search Tojek_VFX on 360cities website.  Exact location of the shot is Downtown Los Angeles, CA, google map latlong, 34.0479269,-118.2299212,
-Full resolution 10000x5000 .exr 360 Panorama 32-bit -Full resolution 10k jpg background image, tonemapped-Low resolution 1000x500 diffuse light map (made seamless and blurry with Diffuse Convolution)-Low res 3k jpg tonemapped preview only image (made with photomatix to accent details)

Car Name: SHC MCE 31
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 47

Car Name: SHC MCE 30
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 50

Car Name: SHC MCE 29
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

Car Name: SHC MCE 28
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 39

They consist of a tread and a body. The tread provides traction while the body provides containment for a quantity of compressed air. Before rubber was developed, the first versions of tires were simply bands of metal fitted around wooden wheels to prevent wear and tear. Early rubber tires were solid (not pneumatic). Pneumatic tires are used on many types of vehicles, including cars, bicycles, motorcycles, buses, trucks, heavy equipment, and aircraft. Metal tires are still used on locomotives and railcars, and solid rubber (or other polymer) tires are still used in various non-automotive applications, such as some casters, carts, lawnmowers, and wheelbarrows.

description_text:
Important: print the model at 90 degrees resting on the wheels!
I designed a cybertruck with spinning wheels and sliding bed cover, the truck is print-in-place without supports, but you will need a good cooling system for it to print nicely.
Variations:
4x4
6x6
The cover is printed separately and it can be a bit tricky to insert it, but it should not be a big problem.
I designed this model to practice and learn some basic 3D modeling principles, this is more of a stepping stone for me, there is a lot more to come from this point on.
I think it turned out great, if you encounter any problems let me know, I want to provide good models for the lowest price possible and at the same time I love having a small income from my little creations, I hope it works for you guys too!
Thank you for your time and enjoy!
3D PRINTING SETTINGS
Layer height: 0.12-0.2 mm
Supports: No
Infill: 5-10%
Wall line count: 3
Top/Bottom layers: 4-5
Print time: 1-5 hours depending on size
Print speed: 50-60 mm/s depending on printer, print it slower if necessary

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 23
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 39
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

description_text:
you can follow more of my work athttp://Politicalsculptor.comhttp://www.instagram.com/mstyle183or follow me on twitter athttp://www.twitter.com/mstyle183http://www.twitter.com/politicalsculpt
if you don't have a 3D printer you can purchase this at https://www.shapeways.com/product/GU9LCJ7JY/runaway-blimp-aka-raytheon-jlens
So everyone a nice piece of military technology at their desk.. a nice fighter jet or a nice tank.. You can buy these already painted and assembled or you can buy nice kits that allows you to do such things. However, i have something even better and is 3D printed!!
You know a fighter jet is a couple of million of dollars.. so are tanks.. but if you are a baller you want something that costed billions.. (but not as expensive as the F-35 which is at Trillions of dollars and doesn't even work yet). i have the perfect piece of military memorabilia
Anyways i'm kind of famous for making plugs as you can see in my website politicalsculptor.com or you can just google "Fernando Sosa 3D".. i didn't choose to be the plug man but it just happened.. So when i saw this plug looking thing on TV for a couple of hours, i was intrigued.. However, When i found this monstrosity, plug looking thing costed the american tax payer almost 4 BILLION DOLLARS.. I went from intrigued to pissed off...
So according to some research i did this is part of a pair of plug balloons, i mean Blimps.. These blimps are flown extremely high and connected with a huge cable to tiny land bases.. I'm guessing the wireless model cost more than 2 billion dollars.. These things suppose to be able to detect missiles and aircrafts that fly very low that aren't detectable by regular radar. Which i think is bull shit because apparently the other "working" blimp wasn't able to detect the run away blimp that had gotten away.
Anyways this extremely expensive ballon somehow got lose and apparently has no way of being controlled since it doesn't appear to have any propellers and the 2 billion dollar remote control that deflates it wasn't working. )i'm guessing the one with propelers and working remote is 3 billion dollars.
So whenever you are working your off at your office and wonder where in the your tax dollars are going.. Now you can stare at this plug looking thing and be assured that your money is making someone at some government contractor like Raytheon or Lockheed Martin very very rich and we are getting some non working piece of military technology that took out the power of about 30,000 people because we did't buy the wireless model..
Disclaimer: This is satire and if Raytheon doesn't wan't to see this kind of embarrassing product being made maybe you should not be over charging us the tax payer with shitty products that don't work and run away!!!
Sources http://www.businessinsider.com/blimp-loose-floats-across-country-military-2015-10 http://foxtrotalpha.jalopnik.com/this-giant-sensor-packed-balloon-is-about-to-watch-over-1635655334/1739241144

description_text:
Mercedes-Benz E class W124 Kombi model 3DW124 is the Mercedes-Benz internal chassis-designation for the 1984/85 to 1995/96 version of the Mercedes-Benz E-Class, as well as the first generation to be officially referred to as E-Class. The W124 models replaced the W123 models after 1985 and were succeeded by the W210 E-Class after 1995.In North America, the W124 was launched in early November 1985 as a 1986 model and sold through the 1995 model year, through November 7, 1995.Series production began at the beginning of November 1984, with press reveal taking place on Monday, November 26, 1984 in Sevilla, Spain, with customer deliveries and European market launch starting in January 1985The W124 was a mid-sized vehicle platform, which entered planning in the autumn of 1976 under development Hans Scherenberg. In July 1977, the W124 program officially began, with R&D commencing work under newly appointed Werner Breitschwerdt. In April 1978, decisions were made to base it on the Mercedes-Benz W201 model program. By April 1979, a package plan was completed for the program, laying out the guidelines of the project. During the winter of 1980–1981, the final exterior for the W124 program was completed, chosen as the leading proposal by design director Bruno Sacco, and approved by the board of management in early 1981. By mid-1982, the first prototypes reflective of the production design, were assembled and sent to testing. In March 1984, pilot production commenced and development of the sedan concluded with engineering sign-off.Front suspension used a separate spring and damper with a rubber top mount. The rear suspension of the W124 featured the Mercedes multi-link axle introduced in 1982 with the Mercedes W201 and which is now standard on many modern cars. Estate cars (and optionally, saloons and coupés) had Citroen-like rear self-leveling suspension with suspension struts rather than shock absorbers, gas-filled suspension spheres to provide damping and an under bonnet pressurizing pump. Unlike the traditional Citroën application Mercedes opted for a fixed ride height and employed rear coil springs to maintain the static ride height when parked.

Double texture option model This Josef Hoffmann Cafe Fledermaus Chair form is widely recognized as a Josef Hoffmann design because it was utilized in his Fledermaus Cabaret late in 1907. description_text:
Wooden carved statue of a sage. Made by scanning a real object.
The real object is located in a city park in one of the provincial cities of eastern Ukraine. The statue was carved from a deletion and installed at the time of the creation of the park. Added a real image of statues to the screenshots. So she looked during the scan. If you are interested in such scans, please report this and I will scan all available statues in the park.The composition includes an original scan of the model with textures. There is also a low-poly model with a LOD group and texurs. Also included is a set of textures prepared for use in PBR rendering and unity (all type rendering), Unreal Engine 4, all textures have a resolution of 4096x4096. Textures for game engines are packaged according to their requirements.
Below is a description of texture packaging for Unity and Unreal Engine 4:
Unity HD render pipeline:Albedo - Base color, Alpha channel: OpacityMask - R channel: Metallic, G channel: Ambient occlusion,  Alpha channel: GlossinessNormal – Normal mapEmissive – Emissive
Unity universal  render pipeline:Albedo - Base color, Alpha channel: OpacityMetallic Smoothness – R channel:  Metallic, Alpha channel: GlossinessSpecular Smoothness - R channel: Specular, Alpha channel: GlossinessNormal – Normal mapEmissive – EmissiveAmbient occlusion -  Ambient occlusion (black and white)
Unreal Engine 4:Base color – RGB channel:  Base color, Alpha channel: OpacityOcclusionRoughnessMetallic: R channel: Mixed AO, G channel: Roughness, B channel: MetallicNormal – Normal mapEmissive – Emissive

Citroen DS Numero 9
Lowpoly model of french concept car.

DS Numero 9 was concept car design around 2012. First shown as the Metropolis concept, this DS9 concept represents a continued design evolution towards a production model which is expected to hit the market in 2013, but surely the production model will lose all of the fancy concept styling elements such as the oversized wheels, headlights and mirrors. Finally car was suspended for production. Design is continuation of DS5 concept with more sophisticated and luxurious lines emphasizing shooting brake design.
My DS9 is altered version to catch even more DS spirit.

3 cars in set: Basic model + flat shaded model + tuned version. Each with own texture/material

Alfa Romeo Brera
Lowpoly model of italian sport coupe.

Alfa Romeo Brera is mid-size sport car using the GM/Fiat Premium platform, manufactured by Pininfarina and marketed by Alfa Romeo as a 2+2 coupé. Brera was originally unveiled as a concept car at the 2002 Geneva Motor Show, designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro. The concept was powered by a Maserati V8 engine rated at around 400 PS (294 kW; 395 hp). The Brera received positive feedback, and Alfa Romeo subsequently announced production plans for 2005. Alfa Romeo Brera was introduced in production form at the 2005 Geneva Motor Show. It translated the original’s exterior appearance on a much smaller scale, becoming a mid-size coupé on platform shared with the Alfa Romeo 159, and designed to replace the outgoing GTV.

description_text:
- Synthetic_matt_plastic_soft_Black.
This is a plastic procedural material for Vray Rendering in 3dsMax 2020.

  -   V_Ray_4.30.00.

  -   3dsMax_2020.

Contain:
The scene contains two plastic materials in two different scales.

  - Synth_matt_plastic_soft_B_V_001       400mm.

  - Synth_matt_plastic_soft_B_V_002      3000mm.

The first one has 400 mm scale. It can be used for some kinds of objects up to 500mm.The second one has 3000mm scale normally used for big objects.
Material Library file you can find inMat_Library_Synth_matt_plastic_soft_B folder.
Separate_Render_Elements:

  - Alpha

  - RGB

  - VRay_Bump_Normal

  - Vray_Diffuse_Filter

  - Vray_Extra_Tex

  - VRay_Globall_Illumination

  - Vray_Lighting

  - Vray_Reflection

  - Vray_Refraction

  - Vray_Sample_Rate

  - Vray_Sampler_Info

  - Vray_Specular

  - Vray_ZDepth

As a background, I used the Showroom.The file contains concrete textures for itin Concrete_Basis_Spotted folder.

  - Dry_Concrete_Spotted_A_baseColour

  - Dry_Concrete_Spotted_A_MetallicSmoothnessA

  - Dry_Concrete_Spotted_A_normal

  - Dry_Concrete_Spotted_A_Roughness

  - Dry_Concrete_Spotted_A_ambientOcclusion

The product folder system looks as following:

  - 3DS_format

  - Concrete_Basis_Spotted

  - Mat_Library_Synth_matt_plastic_soft_B

  - Material_presentation_renders

  - Max_file

  - Render_3500_2625_preset_V_Ray_4.30.00

  - Vray_Settings

  - Z_depth_Cameras_information

How to import materials in your scene?
At first, open your Material Editor (press M in 3DsMax).On the left under the material slots (under the left arrow) click on the Get material button.For effective work you need to make your Material/Map Browser old school.On the left side choose Mtl Library, File-Open-find mtl_file in Mat_Library_Synth_matt_plastic_soft_B folder.Take one of the materials and drag and drop the selected slot of your Material Editor.
- Software : 3Dsmax 2020. Renderer : VRay 4.30.00  - Let the Power be with you!

  - the front wheels are also parented to the _FWRotation_ object, which does what it says but on the Z-axis

description_text:
A decrepit car is a car that is often old and damaged and is in a barely functional state. There are many slang terms used to describe such cars, the more popular including junk car,[1] beater, clunker, hooptie, jalopy, shitbox, junker, and banger.
Age, neglect, and damage tend to increase the expense of maintaining a vehicle. The vehicle may reach a point where this expense would be considered to outweigh the value of keeping it. Such vehicles are generally stripped for parts or abandoned. However, abandoning a vehicle on the road as a parked car is illegal in many jurisdictions and if a vehicle remains parked, the local authority commonly tows it to the scrapyard.[2][3] Some owners choose to keep the vehicle. These old, neglected, and oftentimes barely functional cars have been used not only for transport, but also as racing vehicles. Their use has earned them a place in popular culture.
Contents1   History2   Terminology2.1 Australian English2.2 British English2.3 North American English3   See also4   References5   External linksHistoryDuring the 1930s, particularly in the wake of the Great Depression, the market for used cars first started to grow and decrepit cars were often a poor man's form of transport. Cheap dealers could obtain the cars for very little, make aesthetic adjustments, and sell the car for much more. Early hot rodders also purchased decrepit cars as the basis for racers, and early stock car racing was called banger racing in the United Kingdom and jalopy racing in the United States.
A jalopy was an old-style class of stock car racing in America, often raced on dirt ovals.[4] It was originally a beginner class behind midgets, but vehicles became more expensive with time.[4] Jalopy races began in the 1930s and ended in the 1960s.[5] The race car needed to be from before around 1941.[4] Notable racers include Parnelli Jones.[5] In the 1960s, the Ministry Of Transport Test (MOT) was introduced, in an effort to increase road safety. Many decrepit cars that were missing important parts such as functioning brakes and lights failed the MOT and were scrapped, ending the age of the decrepit car, at least in England.Numerous slang terms are used to describe such cars, which vary by country and region, including hooptie, jalopy, shed, clunker, lemon, banger, bomb, beater, bunky, old bomb, rust bucket, voodoo, wreck, heap, bucket, paddock basher, paddock bomb, death trap, disaster on wheels, rattletrap, or shitbox.
Australian EnglishIn Australian slang the terms rust bucket, bunky, old bomb, paddock basher or bomb are used to refer to old, rusty and/or rundown cars.[6] The term 'paddock bomb' or 'paddock basher' often refers specifically to a car no longer fit to drive on public roads, but driven in a local paddock for recreation or sport. Many rural children learn to drive in an unregulated way in a paddock bomb.
The term shitbox may refer to an unprepossessing but probably roadworthy vehicle, celebrated in the biannual (autumn and spring) Shitbox Rally, an Australian fundraiser for cancer charities.[7]
British EnglishIn British slang the terms old rust bucket or simply bucket are used to refer to decrepit cars but the favoured term is old banger, often shortened to banger. The origin of the word is unknown, but could refer to the older poorly maintained vehicles' tendency to back-fire.[citation needed] The term shed is also used.
North American English
A Missouri family of five who are seven months from the drought area on U.S. Highway 99 (Tracy vicinity) with a jalopy car during the Great DepressionIn North American slang jalopy, clunker, heap, rust bucket and bucket are also used. So too are beater—a term especially favored in Canada—and the American urban hooptie, which gained some popularity from the humorous song My Hooptie by Sir Mix-a-Lot.
The word jalopy was once common but is now somewhat archaic. Jalopy seems to have replaced flivver, which in the early decades of the 20th century also simply meant a failure.[8] Other early terms for a wreck of a car included heap, tin lizzy (1915) and crate (1927), which probably derived from the WWI pilots' slang for an old, slow and unreliable aeroplane. In the latter half of the 20th century more coarse terms became popular, such as shitbox.
The origin of jalopy is unknown, but the earliest written use that has been found was in 1924.[9] It is possible that the longshoremen in New Orleans referred to the scrapped autos destined for scrapyards in Jalapa, Mexico, according to this destination, in which they pronounced the letter J as in English.[9] Another possible origin is the French chaloupe, motorboat, perhaps imitating the sound an old car would make.[10]
A 1929 definition of jalopy reads as follows: a cheap make of automobile; an automobile fit only for junking.[11] The definition has stayed the same, but it took a while for the spelling to standardize. Among the variants have been jallopy, jaloppy, jollopy, jaloopy, jalupie, julappi, jalapa and jaloppie. John Steinbeck spelled it gillopy in In Dubious Battle (1936).[12] The term was used extensively in the book On the Road by Jack Kerouac, first published in 1957, although written from 1947.
The Georgia Institute of Technology, an engineering school in Atlanta, takes pride in the practice of engineering students maintaining antique cars, and the school maintains the Ramblin' Wreck, a popular mascot of the school. Their college radio station, WREK, is also named after the iconic car.
The term was also used throughout the history of Archie Comics, specifically referring to Archie Andrews' red, open-top antique car.
In 2009 the term clunker was heavily used in reference to the Car Allowance Rebate System in the United States, which was also known as the Cash for Clunkers Program.
Decrepit cars used on Indian reservations in the United States and Indian reserves in Canada are often referred to by their owners as reservation cars or rez runners for short.[13] The culture of the rez car was explored in the documentary film Reel Injun,[14] and also figured briefly in the feature film Smoke Signals. Keith Secola (Ojibwa) recorded the song NDN KARS describing such a vehicle in 1987. Originally appearing as a cassette release, it was used in the Native critically acclaimed film Dance Me Outside. It is on his album Circle (AKINA Records, 1992).[15] Activist Russell Means's humorous poem Indian Cars Go Far (1993) also describes the Indian car as a decrepit vehicle.

Lowpoly model of british luxury SUV

The Land Rover Range Rover Velar (generally known simply as the Range Rover Velar) is a crossover SUV produced by British automotive company Jaguar Land Rover under their Land Rover marque. The fourth model in the Range Rover line, the Velar was unveiled in March 2017. The new design language features smoother lines on the body, and emphasises sportiness and on-road ability, but more important is the new interior design language that begins with the Velar, which will later spread to other Range Rover models. Simple low-poly game-ready Stylized Fantasy Plant model made in 3ds Max 2023 and textured in Substance Painter.
Model details:

  - Model pack contains .fbx / .max / .blend and .obj file formats. Textures aren’t embedded into each format and have to be plugged in manually (.fbx and .max files contain basic material with textures plugged in it)

  - You might want to rescale the model to match scene size

  - Nothing is overlapping

  - Model is centered to the middle of its bottom part and placed to 0.0.0 scene coordinates

  - Model is split into multiple separate elements, some pivot points may be missplaced

  - Textures come in 2k resolution, single UV map

  - Texture pack contains .png textures (Arnold, Corona, .glTF, DocChanNormAo, VrayNextMet, PBR, UE4 and Unity)

  - Nothing is animated

  - UV maps and GM model can be seen in screenshots section

  - Renders were made in SP Iray renderer

As usual: best wishes and have a nice day!:D

description_text:
An SUV, or Sport Utility Vehicle, is a type of vehicle that combines elements of a traditional passenger car with features typically found in off-road vehicles or trucks. SUVs are known for their versatility, spacious interiors, higher ground clearance, and often, all-wheel-drive capability. Here are some key characteristics and features of SUVs:
Body Style: SUVs typically have a taller and more upright body compared to sedans or hatchbacks, providing a commanding view of the road and ample interior space for passengers and cargo. They may come in various configurations, including two-row (5-seater) and three-row (7-seater) models.Ground Clearance: SUVs often have higher ground clearance than traditional cars, allowing them to navigate rough terrain or obstacles more easily. This feature also contributes to a more commanding driving position and improved visibility.Versatility: SUVs are designed to be versatile and adaptable to various driving conditions and lifestyles. They can comfortably transport passengers and luggage for daily commuting, family outings, or long road trips. Additionally, many SUVs offer towing capabilities, making them suitable for hauling trailers or recreational vehicles.All-Wheel Drive (AWD) or Four-Wheel Drive (4WD): Many SUVs come equipped with AWD or 4WD systems, providing enhanced traction and stability in challenging road conditions, such as snow, mud, or gravel. This feature is especially valuable for drivers living in regions with inclement weather or off-road enthusiasts seeking adventure.Safety Features: SUVs often come with advanced safety features and driver assistance technologies to enhance occupant protection and mitigate the risk of accidents. These may include adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, automatic emergency braking, and blind-spot monitoring systems.Fuel Efficiency: While some SUVs are known for their fuel efficiency, especially those with hybrid or electric powertrains, others may have higher fuel consumption due to their larger size and heavier weight. However, advancements in engine technology and aerodynamics have improved the fuel efficiency of many modern SUVs.Overall, SUVs appeal to a wide range of consumers, from families seeking space and versatility to outdoor enthusiasts craving adventure and capability. With their combination of comfort, performance, and utility, SUVs continue to be popular choices in the automotive market worldwide.

description_text: This is a model of a Tesla Cyber Pickup electric car that can be made using 3D printing technology, designed at a scale of 1:20, with a total length of 280mm, a width of 105mm (excluding mirrors), and a height of 91mm. With the exception of the electrical part, all parts are 3D printed. The electrical part contains two 3mm wide light strips and a power supply circuit.The model's doors, body doors, and trunk lid can be opened and closed, the wipers can be rotated, the mirrors can be folded, the body cover can be slid and retracted (there is not enough internal space, and the last 20mm cannot be retracted), the wheels can be rotated, the front wheels can be steered, and the front and rear lights can be switched on and off. There is no electric function.If there is no need for lights, then all the electronic parts can be left uninstalled, and the assembly and other movements of the model will not be affected.The whole model contains 50 kinds and 86 3D printed parts; 5 electrical components.

Unleash exciting adventures with the 60369 Mobile Police Dog Training set! This action-packed kit features a mobile training unit complete with a cool police van, agility equipment, and, of course, loyal police dogs ready for action.   - Assembly Guide: Once you have printed all the LEGO brick components, you can download a detailed assembly instruction file to assist you in assembling the parts together.

The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL (chassis code W 198) is a two-seat sports car which was produced by Mercedes-Benz as a gullwinged coupe (1954–1957) and roadster (1957–1963).[2] It was based on the company's 1952 racer, the W194, with mechanical direct fuel injection which boosted power almost 50 percent in its three-liter overhead camshaft straight-six engine. Capable of reaching a top speed of up to 263 km/h (163 mph), it was a sports car racing champion and the fastest production car of its time.Max Hoffman, Mercedes-Benz's United States importer at the time, inspired the 300 SL and saw an American market for such a car. The company introduced the 300 SL in February 1954 at the International Motor Sports Show in New York City (instead of Europe) to get it into US buyers' hands sooner.
SL is the short form for super-light in German (super-leicht)– Mercedes' first use of the designation, referring to the car's racing-bred light tubular-frame construction. The 300 SL was voted the sports car of the century in 1999.

description_text:
This is a model of a car wheel. The model is in real life scale.It includes:

  - Tire (high detail, lots of sufaces)

  - Rim

  - Brake disc

  - Brake caliper (low detail)

  - Bolts x5 (low detail)

  - Wheel (the assembly of the listed above)

The dimensions are 200/50 R17 (it is inscribed in the tire, just as in real life tires).The meaning of those dimensions is:

  - 200mm widht (tire)

  - Outer diameter - inner diameter = 50% of the width (aka 100mm)

  - 17 inches inner diameter (thus the wheel's rim is a 17in)

You can scale it up or down to your needs, however the numbers inscribed in the tire only make sense as it is now.The textures used for the renders are not included.
Hope you like it, feel free to ask or suggest anything :)

description_text:

description_text:
A realistic model of the Swedish 1892 steam car “Cederholmaren”. Currently the oldest, still functioning Swedish-built car in the world.
The car was contructed in Ystad, Sweden by two brothers, Anders Cederholm, a painter, and Jöns Cederholm, who was a blacksmith. The cartwright Eliasson also helped by making the seats and some wooden details. Only two examples of the car were ever constructed, the first one broke down and then crashed the very first time it was driven, it was very hard to drive and had no brakes. After crashing the first model the brothers constructed a second one, which was easier to drive. This car had poor reliability, but the brothers managed to take some pleasure trips in it. The car was mocked by the people in Ystad and was later left sitting until Manfred Almquist renovated it nearly 100 years later.
Further reading (Swedish) : https://ymhm.se/?page_id=789
Modeled in Blender, textured in Substance Painter.
1 4K PBR Texture set, 2 Materials (One for glass shader)
Model is split up into 28 different parts, most use mirrored UV's.

description_text:
3D Bentley Flying Spur model made with Blender 2.9. Textures packed to blend file. If you download other formats you may need to download textures too.Thanks
The Bentley Flying Spur (formerly the Bentley Continental Flying Spur) is a luxury saloon produced by Bentley Motors Limited since 2005 and was released in 2006. It is the four-door variant of the Bentley Continental GT coupé.
The car is manufactured at Bentley's factory in Crewe, England. Briefly, due to a lack of capacity at the Crewe factory upon the car's introduction, some Flying Spurs destined for markets other than the United States and the United Kingdom were built at Volkswagen's Transparent Factory in Dresden, Germany. This arrangement ended in 2006 when all assembly work reverted to CreweThe third-generation Flying Spur was unveiled in June 2019. The car has been completely overhauled and is built on a brand-new platform, resembling the current Continental GT. The front receives a new grille with vertical slats akin to that of a Rolls-Royce, while the rear features new taillights that incorporate a B motif. The hood ornament is now illuminated at night, electrically deployable, and capable of meeting pedestrian impact requirements. Rear-wheel steering is new and is accompanied by air springs with 60 percent more volume than its predecessor. The all-wheel drive system is also new and uses an electronically controlled clutch pack. The interior boasts a rotating 12.3-inch (31.2-cm) display and an all-new Touch Screen remote that allows rear occupants to control several systems. Compared to the second generation model, the new Flying Spur gets close to 130 mm additional wheelbase. It accelerates from 0-60 mph in 3.7 seconds and reaches a maximum speed of 207 mph(333 km/h).
The Flying Spur will become the only Bentley sedan model, as production of the Mulsanne ends in the second quarter of 2020 without a direct successor.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR RIM 7 GAME READY RIM TIRE AND DISC
Ortas presents you Rim no 7.
*** Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.
*** Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game.
*** Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.
*** Using this rim is very easy in your games, for the reason that we have tested the wheel in game engines and settled the directions. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file plug it into your car and it is done.
*** In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.
*** In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 
*** All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.
*** We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see and purchase many other tires.
*** Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. 
*** Every single rim that we have designed is unique.
In conclusion; very easy to use and very easy to modify. We hope you like it.Don't forget to check out our all portfolio. We have a wide variety of models and much more will be coming soon.
Thanks for your interest for our models.
Best Regards.

description_text:
ORTAS CAR WHEEL RIM 83 GAME READY WHEEL RIM TIRE
Ortas presents you Wheel Rim no 83.

  - Consisting of nine parts. Main outer rim, side rim, tire, middle, screws and braking disc. Disc also consisting of four parts; two discs, metal balls inside of the disc and braking mechanism.

  - Very easy to use and modify. All the parts are parented under the main outer rim. Objects are not joined together so that you can use the wheel as we have designed or easily change the parts according to your project or game. To make the modification easier for you, we are giving you the Blend file.

  - Disc parts are also parented under the disc so you can also change the parts of the disc if you want to do so.

  - Using this rim is very easy in your games, the tire, wheel and rim is tested in game engines and the directions are settled. So if you want to use it in your game, simply import the fbx file; plug it into your car and it is done!

  - In order to make things easier for you we are giving you the left side rim and the right side rim seperately. First file is the right and the second file is the left side wheel. Simply plug them in into your car without dealing with directions.

  - In order to take the same sight as you see in the preview pictures. Increase the metalic value and/or smoothness value of the parts that are metal. 

  - All the materials are embedded in the fbx file. We have used many materials in order to give the realistic view.

  - We are also giving you a 10 $ tire for free with the rim. Check out our tire portfolio to see, investigate and purchase many other types of tires.

  - Polygon and Verticals count is the number with the tire. Tire poly count is around 10.000. So the only rim's poly count is around 10.000 less than the number indicated.

  - Every single rim that we have designed is unique. By the time we write this description there are 140 different types of rims in our portfolio. So check them all out and buy the one you like the most. (You should also check our rim collections in order to buy more and pay less.)

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 22
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

description_text:
Lada Samara with a Pyongyang Car Plate
The VAZ-2108, known as the Lada Samara in much of Western Europe (codenamed and later officially badged as the Lada Sputnik in its native Russia), was a series of small family cars produced by Soviet/Russian vehicle manufacturer AvtoVAZ under the Lada brand between 1984 and 2013. The model name Samara originally was used only for exported models, in the Soviet Union the same model was called Sputnik (fellow traveler, satellite) until 1991, when the sedan version of the Samara entered in production, using the export name. It was the first front-wheel drive serial car built in the Soviet Union after the LuAZ-969V. The Samara had been modified and restyled during the years of production before it was finally discontinued in December 2013.
The Samara was to build on the success of the traditional Fiat 124-based range, by providing a car that combined a robust build and ease of maintenance with a modern style. It was produced in various three, four and five-door designs with 1.1, 1.3 and 1.5-litre petrol engines. Lada had hoped that the Samara would enable it to compete for sales in the mainstream European car market. It was the second autonomous design from AvtoVAZ (the first was the Niva SUV), and the first Lada car not based on the Fiat-derived mechanicals.
